title: About the author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR R onald Malfi is the award-winning author of several horror novels and thrillers, including the bestseller Come with Me , published by Titan Books in 2021. He is the recipient of two Independent Publisher Book Awards, the Beverly Hills Book Award, the Vincent Preis Horror Award, the Benjamin Franklin Award, and his novel Floating Staircase was a finalist for the Bram Stoker Award ® . He lives with his family along the Chesapeake Bay, and when he’s not writing, he’s performing in the rock band VEER. ronaldmalfi.com @RonaldMalfi
